how.title: HOW TO PLAY
how.sub: Walk, sidestep and circle the ring, attack, defend.
how.hint: The ring is round. Walk around it.
how.walk.d: Toward or away from your opponent. Hold away from them to block, down-away to block low.
how.jump.d: Up jumps; add forward or back to jump that way. Down crouches under high attacks.
how.dash.d: Tap forward twice. Back twice is a backdash.
how.sidestep.d: Tap STEP IN (away from the camera) or STEP OUT (toward it): a quick step around your opponent, off the attack line.
how.circle.d: Hold STEP to keep walking around the ring, your opponent always in front of you. Hold back to stop and block.
how.stepatk.d: Attack during a sidestep or a circle walk. Some contestants have a special STEP + H move.
how.homing.d: They turn to catch a sidestep. The MOVE LIST marks them.
how.linear.d: They fly straight. Step off the line and they miss you.
how.wall.d: Knock them into the wall for a WALL SPLAT. Circle off it when you are the one pinned.
how.normals.d: Light is fast, heavy hits hard. Add a direction for crouching and command attacks.
how.special.d: SIMPLE: SP alone or with a direction. CLASSIC: motion inputs.
how.super.d: SP + H with a SHOWTIME bar. Down + SP + H with three bars: PRIME TIME.
how.assist.d: Hold it and tap L for an auto combo. ASSIST + SP = an EX special (2 NERVE bars).
how.throw.d: Up close (or L + M). Press THROW as you are grabbed to escape.
how.parry.d: Hold to parry everything (or M + H). Tap right as a hit lands for a PERFECT PARRY.
how.impact.d: An armored strike that soaks two hits. Near the wall it splats them.

ending.title: {name} WINS THE SEASON
ending.default: The cameras stay on long after the last punch. Tomorrow the whole city knows the name.
ending.johnny: JOHNNY RIOT walks out of the Control Room with the host's microphone in one hand and the season in the other. By Monday his face is on every billboard the network owns. He takes them down himself.
ending.patch: PATCH never wanted the fame. She takes the prize money, buys the rooftop from the network and turns it into a free gym for every kid who ever got told to sit down.
ending.bruno: BRUNO carries the trophy home on his shoulder like a fridge. The network wants a spin-off. He signs with one condition: every episode ends with a cooking segment.
ending.zambini: THE GREAT ZAMBINI bows, snaps his fingers and the trophy vanishes. So does the network's archive. Nobody can prove the season happened, except him.
ending.krane: OFFICER KRANE files a very long report about what happens under the studio. The report goes missing. Krane keeps a copy under the shield.
ending.lotus: LOTUS LIU raises one glass to the crowd, one to the host, and one to herself. Then she wanders off the set and nobody can find her for a week.
ending.boneyard: BONEYARD hangs the host's sequined jacket on a hook in the meat locker. The network calls it a hostile takeover. He calls it Tuesday.
ending.spin: SPIN lands the final move on live television and the clip loops for a month. Every dance crew in the city is suddenly training for next season.
ending.gazza: GAZZA volleys the trophy into the upper deck and the crowd carries it out into the street. The network bills him for the trophy. He frames the bill.
ending.rerun: RERUN finally stays down, on purpose, with the trophy on his chest. The network renews him for another season. He was never really gone.
ending.freak: THE FREAK tears the chest number off and walks out of the studio into the rain. For the first time in years, nobody is holding the leash.
ending.ricky: RICKY MARQUEE beats every contestant on his own show. The ratings are the best in network history. He smiles into camera two and says: same time next week.

host.ricky.title: RICKY MARQUEE
trait.johnny: HEADLINER JAB: 4-frame 5L (+4 on hit) links into itself; on a punish counter (+8) it links into 5M. The only light in the cast that links.
trait.patch: RED LIGHT REKKA: CUE KICK chains into CUE 2, then CUE 3 overhead (236) or low (214). Fastest walk (2.28 m/s) and longest dash (1.43 m); lowest HP (9500), no projectile.
trait.spin: LOW PROFILE + AIR: floor normals (2L/2M/2H), WINDMILL and SIX STEP shrink his hurtbox under highs and projectiles; DROP-IN is an air-only dive kick; floatiest jump (apex 1.75 m, 40 air frames).

ml.classicTip: CLASSIC: motion + L / M / H for a special at that strength, motion + S for EX.
ml.how.none: No special system: this kit wins on fundamentals and the edge above.
ml.how.stance: Enter the stance with its special; in the stance L / M / H fire the follow-ups, DOWN leaves it, holding BACK blocks.
ml.how.charge: Hold BACK (or DOWN) for about 3/4 of a second, then press FORWARD (or UP) + a button. SIMPLE: S + direction, no charge.
ml.how.ball: One ball on the field: shoot it, bounce it off a wall, park it above your head, walk over it to pick it back up.
ml.how.counter: The counter move catches a strike and answers at once. Throws and command grabs beat it.
ml.how.armorStep: Armored moves walk through a hit and keep going. Throws, IMPACT and multi-hit attacks break the armor.
ml.how.teleport: Teleport moves vanish and reappear behind the opponent or back home in your corner.
ml.how.phases: Below half health the second phase starts for the rest of the bout: new moves and a second PRIME TIME.
ending.renewed: The network renews the show. Same time next season.
res.rematchWait: REMATCH ASKED - WAITING FOR YOUR OPPONENT
trait.boneyard: ARMOR: 5H, MEAT HOOK and BUTCHER'S BLOCK absorb a hit; big damage per touch, no DP.
trait.bruno: ARMOR STEP: BRACE walks through one hit into WALK-IN FREEZER or a 2L tick; FRIDGE DOOR walls them in.
trait.freak: BOSS ARMOR: 5H, 6H and every special take 2 hits of armor; 2.40 m reach and 11,500 HP.
trait.gazza: THE BALL: one ball on screen - shoot it, park it with KEEPY-UPPY, volley it later; one wall rebound.
trait.krane: CHARGE + RIOT SHIELD: [4]6 and [2]8 specials; blocking standing drains half the NERVE.
trait.lotus: SWAY STANCE: leans out of high attacks; L low, M overhead, H hop over lows.
trait.rerun: PLAY DEAD: drops to the floor and catches strikes on frames 4-20, then rises into a counter.
trait.ricky: TWO PHASES: below 50% HP the set goes live - PYRO fire lines and a second Lv3, SEASON FINALE.
trait.zambini: VANISHING ACT: trapdoor teleport behind the opponent or home to his corner; keeps you at 3-5 m.
